Tax Advisory Services

In partnership with 50 International, we offer comprehensive tax advisory services tailored to high-net-worth individuals and families. Our approach goes beyond conventional tax planning, addressing complex national and international matters with clarity and precision.

Global Asset Review

• Detailed analysis of business and personal interests

• Assessment of capital tax status, liquidity, and projected values

• Foundation for effective cross-border structuring and tax advice

Tax Analysis

• Strategic planning for non-domicile taxation

• Bespoke analysis of assets and their history

• Addressing historic issues and utilizing available tax reliefs and exemptions

Structure & Governance

• Implementation of tax-efficient structures

• Intergenerational asset control

• Regular reviews to adapt to changing circumstances and legislation

Additional Services

• Visa and passport assistance across jurisdictions

• Banking solutions

• Access to capital and business fund raising

• Investor strategies

• Intergenerational wealth planning

• Asset discovery

• Reputational repair

At Karl Finance, we understand that tax matters can often feel complex and confusing. Through our partnership with 50 International, we strive to make these intricate issues understandable, providing you with clear, effective solutions tailored to your specific needs.

Our Process

  • Review: We help articulate your short to long-term strategy, considering your background, concerns, and objectives.
  • Advise: Based on a detailed review, we prepare an accurate summary for senior tax counsel, ensuring depth and precision in our advice.
  • Implement: We execute the required structures, provide management and control support, and conduct regular oversight to ensure ongoing compliance and family care.
